title: German Potato Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired potato casserole, perfect for a cold winter evening. This dish combines tender potatoes with crispy onions and a rich beef broth.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
In a large skillet, sauté the sliced onions in butter until they are golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, combine the beef broth and milk. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the flour to the saucepan and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the mixture thickens.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of potatoes. Top with a layer of sautéed onions, followed by a layer of the beef broth mixture.
Repeat the layering process two more times, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top layer of potatoes.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
